findings.title: Ingest jobs has no dead-letter queue
findings.message: If Chunk and embed can't handle a message, it's dropped after 5 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
